correctness.rationale: The two composites are right composition by the common-lower and common-upper kernels, so universal commutation is exactly equality of those kernels. If equal, their common relation is transitive by a direct two-stage common-bound argument and hence is comparability-component equivalence. Finiteness upgrades pairwise common bounds to component endpoints; the converse is immediate. Component saturation is fixed by both closures and is least by propagation along comparability zigzags. Direct composition preserves both p-conditions. Fresh exhaustive replay verified the order criterion on all labelled posets through four points.
